title: Aureline M5 migration scoreboard
description: Canonical per-domain migration scoreboard for the migration-scoreboard object. Names the scoreboard entry, its supported line association, the scored migration path, the tracked migration blockers, the recorded migration-pain deltas, the scoreboard version, and its export class so migration pain is never forgotten between release trains and every scoreboard row stays versioned, current, and joined to exact build/release-line identity. Downstream release, help, docs, support, and program-governance surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a line's migration posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
